EmailTemplate.description: Reminder to action x days remaining before renewal
EmailTemplate.name: Opportunity: Pending Renewal
EmailTemplate.subject: Renewal Reminder: {!Opportunity.Account} ({!Opportunity.Days_until_next_renewal_due__c} days)
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!Opportunity.OwnerFirstName},
Your renewal opportunity for {!Opportunity.Name} at the amount of {!Opportunity.Amount} is {!Opportunity.Days_until_next_renewal_due__c} from renewal with a status of {!Opportunity.StageName}. Please start the renewal conversation with your POC {!Opportunity.Primary_Client_Contact__c} and update the opportunity to reflect the status here: {!Opportunity.Link}
A reminder of the targeted Stage for the 7 days leading up to renewal:
3 months - Gather Client Feedback 2 1/2 months - Draft Renewal Documents 2 months - Negotiations/Draft Contract Sent for Client Review 1 1/2 months - Contract Sent 1 month or less - Contract Received/Change Opportunity to Win
Thanks, Sales Ops
